name: Freed vs Mentalyc
title: Freed vs Mentalyc: AI Scribe Comparison for Therapists (2026)
description: Compare Freed and Mentalyc AI scribes for mental health professionals. See differences in pricing, note templates, HIPAA compliance, and which is best for therapists.

summary.bottom_line: Freed is a general-purpose ambient AI scribe with broader medical applications and cleaner HPI generation. Mentalyc is purpose-built for mental health with therapy-specific note formats (DAP, SOAP, BIRP) and deeper customization for behavioral health workflows. Therapists often prefer Mentalyc; prescribers doing medication management may prefer Freed.

key_differences.specialization: Freed (general medical) vs Mentalyc (mental health specific)
key_differences.note_formats: Mentalyc (more therapy templates) vs Freed (broader medical)
key_differences.customization: Mentalyc (deeper MH customization) vs Freed (simpler setup)

sections.heading: Freed vs Mentalyc: Overview
sections.content: Freed and Mentalyc are both AI-powered documentation assistants that use ambient listening to generate clinical notes from therapy sessions. Freed is a general-purpose medical AI scribe that works across specialties including mental health. Mentalyc was built specifically for mental health professionals with therapy-specific note formats and deeper customization for behavioral health workflows. Both are HIPAA-compliant and offer BAAs.

sections.heading: Note Templates & Formats
sections.content: Mentalyc has the edge for therapists with its extensive library of mental health-specific templates including DAP, SOAP, BIRP, GIRP, and specialized intake/progress note formats. It also handles treatment plan generation better than Freed. Freed offers standard SOAP and DAP formats plus broader medical note types, making it more versatile for prescribers who split time between medication management and other medical work. Freed is known for cleaner HPI (History of Present Illness) generation.

sections.heading: Pricing Comparison
sections.content: Freed offers transparent tiered pricing: $39/month (Starter, 40 notes), $79/month (Core, unlimited notes), and $119/month (Premier, advanced features). Mentalyc's pricing is in a similar range but requires contacting sales for exact quotes. Both offer free trials. For therapists seeing 40+ sessions monthly, Freed's Core plan at $79/month offers good value with unlimited notes.

sections.heading: Documentation Quality
sections.content: Neither Freed nor Mentalyc is perfect for psychiatry-specific workflows. Both will require consistent editing for complex psychiatric evaluations, dual medication/psychotherapy documentation, and structured risk assessment language. Freed earns praise for cleaner HPI generation and has a more developed template library for mental health follow-ups. Mentalyc offers more structured mental status exam fields but clinicians report needing to add clinical language manually for complex cases.

sections.heading: Which Should You Choose?
sections.content: Match the tool to your clinical workflow:

recommendations.when: You're a therapist doing primarily talk therapy, you need therapy-specific note formats (BIRP, GIRP), you want treatment plan generation, or you use SimplePractice/TherapyNotes and want tighter integration
You're a prescriber doing medication management visits, you want cleaner HPI generation, you prefer simpler setup with transparent pricing, or you work across multiple medical specialties
You need deep psychiatric documentation (ICANotes), specific EHR integration (native AI scribes), or handle complex dual diagnosis cases

faqs.q: Is Freed or Mentalyc better for therapists?
faqs.a: For therapists doing primarily talk therapy, Mentalyc is typically better due to its mental health-specific note templates (DAP, BIRP, GIRP), treatment plan generation, and deeper customization for therapy workflows. Freed works well but is more general-purpose.

faqs.q: Are Freed and Mentalyc HIPAA compliant?
faqs.a: Yes, both Freed and Mentalyc are HIPAA compliant and provide Business Associate Agreements (BAAs). Freed offers BAA on all paid plans. Always verify current compliance status before signing up.

faqs.q: Which is cheaper: Freed or Mentalyc?
faqs.a: Freed has more transparent pricing starting at $39/month for 40 notes, $79/month for unlimited, and $119/month for premium features. Mentalyc's pricing is similar but requires contacting sales. For high-volume therapists, both land in the $79-119/month range.

faqs.q: Can Freed or Mentalyc integrate with my EHR?
faqs.a: Both primarily work via copy/paste into any EHR. Mentalyc has tighter integrations with SimplePractice and TherapyNotes. Freed offers some direct EHR integrations depending on your system. Neither has the deep native integration of EHR-specific AI tools.
